# VectorForce

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("VectorForce")`

Applies a constant force to the part that `Attachment0` is on. Use it for a thruster, for wind on one object or for lift.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ApplyAtCenterOfMass` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the force is applied at the part's center of mass instead of at the attachment. When it is off, a force away from the center also turns the part. |
| `Force` | `vector` | `vector.create(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The force, in newtons, in the frame that `RelativeTo` names. |
| `RelativeTo` | `Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo` | `Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachment0` | read/write | The frame the force is given in. `Attachment0`, the default, makes a thruster: the force follows the part as it turns. |
